title: 酒店前台秒变熟人？5句英语拿捏！🏨

cover.style_keywords: 清爽蓝白配色、手绘风酒店前台插画、气泡对话框、手机翻译软件被轻轻推开的幽默小细节

slides.correct_en: Hi, I’ve got a reservation under Li Wei — just made it yesterday.
slides.correct_cn: 你好，李伟名下有预订，是昨天刚下的。

dialogue.a: A: Hi, I’ve got a reservation under Li Wei — just made it yesterday.
dialogue.a_cn: A：你好，李伟名下有预订，是昨天刚下的。
dialogue.b: B: Perfect! Here’s your key card — room 803, facing the garden.
dialogue.b_cn: B：好的！这是您的房卡——803房，朝花园。

slides.tip: 用‘I’ve got a reservation under…’代替‘I booked…’，自带确认感+轻描淡写的从容，比翻手机查订单还显老练～

slides.correct_en: Just checking — is this the garden-view room I booked? I love waking up to greenery!
slides.correct_cn: 想确认下，这是不是我订的园景房？超爱一睁眼就看到绿植的感觉～

dialogue.a: A: Just checking — is this the garden-view room I booked? I love waking up to greenery!
dialogue.a_cn: A：想确认下，这是不是我订的园景房？超爱一睁眼就看到绿植的感觉～
dialogue.b: B: Yes! And we’ve upgraded you to a corner suite — enjoy the extra light.
dialogue.b_cn: B：是的！还为您免费升级到了转角套房——采光更棒哦。

slides.tip: 把疑问藏在赞美里（I love…），既礼貌又暗示你懂行，升级概率up⬆️

slides.correct_en: Could you tell me when breakfast service wraps up? I’m an early riser!
slides.correct_cn: 请问早餐供应到几点？我习惯早起～

dialogue.a: A: Could you tell me when breakfast service wraps up? I’m an early riser!
dialogue.a_cn: A：请问早餐供应到几点？我习惯早起～
dialogue.b: B: It runs until 10:30 — and we can pack a ‘grab-and-go’ bag if you need to leave earlier.
dialogue.b_cn: B：供应到10:30，如果您要提前走，我们还能帮您准备便携早餐包。

slides.tip: 用‘wraps up’替代‘starts/ends’，地道又轻松；加一句‘I’m an early riser’瞬间拉近距离，还显得生活规律✨

slides.correct_en: Would it be possible to add an extra pillow? My neck’s been a bit stiff lately.
slides.correct_cn: 能麻烦多加一个枕头吗？最近脖子有点僵～

dialogue.a: A: Would it be possible to add an extra pillow? My neck’s been a bit stiff lately.
dialogue.a_cn: A：能麻烦多加一个枕头吗？最近脖子有点僵～
dialogue.b: B: Absolutely — I’ll send one up right away. Also, here’s a hot towel for your shoulders!
dialogue.b_cn: B：当然可以——马上给您送上去！另外，这是热毛巾，给肩膀放松一下～

slides.tip: 用‘Would it be possible…?’开头，再加个无伤大雅的小理由（stiff neck），服务生会秒变贴心管家👩‍💼

slides.wrong_en: I want low floor, no smoke room!
slides.correct_en: If it’s not too much trouble — would a lower-floor, non-smoking room be available? I’m traveling with my grandma.
slides.correct_cn: 如果不太麻烦的话——方便安排一间低楼层、无烟的房间吗？这次是陪奶奶一起旅行。

dialogue.a: A: If it’s not too much trouble — would a lower-floor, non-smoking room be available? I’m traveling with my grandma.
dialogue.a_cn: A：如果不太麻烦的话——方便安排一间低楼层、无烟的房间吗？这次是陪奶奶一起旅行。
dialogue.b: B: Of course! Let me switch you to room 205 — elevator’s right outside, and it’s our quietest wing.
dialogue.b_cn: B：当然可以！马上为您换到205房——电梯就在门口，还是我们最安静的楼层。

slides.tip: ‘If it’s not too much trouble…’是万能软化剂；加上真实人设（traveling with grandma）立刻激发共情，拒绝率≈0%

caption:
前台看你掏出手机翻翻译软件的瞬间，气场就输了！😅真正流利的人，开口第一句就带着‘我常住’的松弛感～这5句不是背单词，是学怎么用英语‘自然地推进对话’：有确认、有理由、有温度、还有点小幽默😉出国前存好，入住时笑着说完，连前台都会多给你两块巧克力🍫！你最想先练哪一句？评论区喊出来～👇
